reason: Money is tight since daycare went up, and we do library storytime, parks and the zoo for free. $15 a visit plus a sibling is way more than I spend on any activity now. I'd take the free first visit, but I probably wouldn't pay after that.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month at most, so a membership or a 5-pack doesn't pay off, and $15 a drop-in is a lot when the park costs nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $8 to $10 for a parent and one kid, or a free-entry weekday morning once in a while.
